unharnessed.meaning: All facts survive: 1/4 point rise to 3-3/4 to 4 percent, ample reserves, unemployment steady, solid growth, inflation above 2 percent, the directive and statement verbatim, the twelve voters, IORB 3.90 percent, primary credit 4.0 percent, next meeting October 27-28, adjournment 10:15 a.m., notation vote of August 18.
unharnessed.sense: Mostly exact ("bump the target range ... up", "hadn't budged much", "running too hot", "The meeting knocked off at 10:15 a.m."), but "doubled down on the FOMC's policy" overstates "reaffirmed" (it implies escalating a risky bet).
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural in the narrated parts: "When the yakking wrapped up", "Not a single bugger.", "the Committee's next get-together". A few lines are pasted-on idiom ("the whole lot of members").
unharnessed.register: The narration is level 4 with dad-level swearing ("Not a single bugger."), but the directive and the statement (about half the text) are left word for word, so overall it is lighter than asked.
unharnessed.tone: The official record's seriousness stays in the quoted blocks; the narration is breezier but keeps the facts straight.
unharnessed.flow: Narration reads well; the switch between yarn and untouched Fed-speak is abrupt.
unharnessed.variety: Varied in the parts it retells: "bump", "doubled down", "running too hot", "crystal clear", "dead set", "yakking", "signing off", "knocked off", "thumbs-up".
unharnessed.essence: Recognisably the minutes; the untouched quoted documents keep it close, but it reads half-retold.

engine.meaning: Facts are garbled: "all members gave raise the target range the nod", "inflation remained elevated rello to", "its continuing swear blind to achieve", and a voter's name split as "Lorie K. Anyway, Logan".
engine.sense: Many wrong senses: "rello" (relative, the family member) for "relative to", "swear blind" for "resolve", "said righto" inside an official vote.
engine.authenticity: Stage-Australian tags bolted on: "Well, bugger me, at the conclusion of the discussion", "Crikey, Productivity growth is strong", "Now, the Committee".
engine.register: Swearing within dad level, but mostly untouched Fed text with stray tags; far from level 4.
engine.tone: Official minutes punctured by random exclamations ("Crikey,").
engine.flow: Broken grammar and joins: "gave raise the target range the nod", "adjourned at 10:15 a.m. Now, on September 16, 2026."
engine.variety: A few filler tags ("Well,", "Now,", "Anyway,") and swaps.
engine.essence: The structure is there, but the content is defaced, including a voter's name.

yarn.meaning: Every fact and figure survives through the directive and statement too: "a cap of $160 billion per counterparty per day", "3 years or less left to run", 12-0, IORB 3.90 percent, primary credit 4.0 percent, dates and times. Asides ("No word of a lie, here's how it went down.", "Back to work, the lot of 'em.") are colour.
yarn.sense: Terms fit: "gave the nod to lifting", "chugging along nicely", "a solid clip", "businesses are splashing out on investment", "Not a single knocker in the room."
yarn.authenticity: Sounds like an Aussie retelling the minutes: "every member around the table gave the nod", "putting it in black and white", "said righto".
yarn.register: Level 4 throughout, including the quoted documents; no swearing beyond dad level (none needed).
yarn.tone: Keeps the facts and the firmness ("The Committee will deliver price stability."), though the opener and "Back to work, the lot of 'em." add a cheekiness the record lacks; within the voice change the brief asks.
yarn.flow: Reads smoothly from start to finish.
yarn.variety: Varied: "gave the nod", "stuck by", "chugging along", "crystal clear", "dead set", "black and white", "solid clip", "splashing out", "hardly budged", "knocker", "righto".
yarn.essence: Unmistakably the FOMC minutes, fully retold.
